target.statement: Toy example: the bag-and-whisker plot flags only z8=(19,20) as an outlier, with data-adaptive inflation factor λ=8 (max(λstat, λdata)) under FWER/FDR/PFER control
target.dataset: Toy dataset of 8 bivariate points given in Section 4

compute.basis: The target is an 8-point hand-verifiable toy example; installing R plus the BagWhiskerPlot/aplpack/MASS packages and running the pipeline takes minutes on a CPU.

title: The Bag-and-Whisker Plot: A New Bagplot for Bivariate Data
